topic: Accessing campaign testing and planner mode
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on granting access for testing campaigns (specifically JCD and CC) and Planner mode. Initially, it was suggested that the beta environment had been functional since Wednesday. Later, a request was made to create user accounts ([email@gmail.com] and [email@gmail.com]) to test Planner mode.

It was noted that continuous changes are being implemented in the beta version, making testing difficult. A decision was reached to delay granting access until after the Tuesday release to ensure testers use the most current version.
decisions: Access for campaign testing and Planner mode will be granted after the Tuesday release.
action_items: Someone needs to provide credentials for setting up test users.
